Step Name:CREATING DATE TABLE AND CALCULATED COLUMN
Detailed Instructions:

STEP 1- Go to Data view then Click create table

STEP 2- Copy and paste this DAX(Date Table = CALENDARAUTO() )then enter

STEP 3- Select the Date table change the date format

STEP 4- go to model view and create one to many relationship

Follow the GIF below to apply the above steps  

Next you can copy paste the DAX for formula I listed below or you can download it as a word document by clicking the above icon

1.    Total Sale = SUM(sales[Total Revnue ])

2.    Total Profit = SUM(sales [Net Profit ])

3.    Gross Profit Margin % = DIVIDE([Total profit],[Total Sales],0)

4.    LY Profit Margin = CALCULATE([Gross Profit Margin %],SAMEPERIODLASTYEAR('Date Table'[Date]))

5.     YOY% = [Gross Profit Margin %]-[LY Profit Margin]

6.    YOY% kpi = SWITCH(TRUE(), [YOY%]<0,UNICHAR(9660),UNICHAR(9650))&ROUND([YOY%],4)*100 & "%"

7.    KPI Arrow = IF([YOY%]>=0, "green","Red")

STEP 1 - Click new measure and copy paste the first DAX formula

STEP 2 – make sure your new measure table is under sales table

you repeat this steps to create Measures for the rest of DAXs I listed above

Follow the GIF below to apply the above steps 

After you create Gross profit margin and YOY% make sure you change display value in percentage

portfolioContent.title: Global Super Store
portfolioContent.portfolioSummary: Developed an interactive Power BI dashboard analyzing global retail sales and profitability from 2011 to 2015.
portfolioContent.summary: This project involved creating a comprehensive Power BI dashboard using the Global Super Store dataset, which contains around 50,000 customer-centric sales records from multiple vendors and markets. The dashboard features data cleaning, calculated metrics, and visualizations such as shape maps and clustered charts to analyze sales performance and profit margins over time.
portfolioContent.businessProblem: Retail businesses need to analyze large volumes of sales data across vendors and markets to identify trends and profitability. Without effective visualization and analysis, decision-makers struggle to optimize sales strategies and improve profit margins.
objectives: Load and clean a large retail sales dataset for analysis
Create calculated metrics to measure sales and profit performance
Develop interactive visualizations to track sales trends and geographic performance
workflow: Import and load the Global Super Store Excel dataset into Power BI
Clean data by removing unwanted columns and correcting data types
Create a date table and define relationships for time-based analysis
Develop calculated columns and measures for sales and profit KPIs
Build and format interactive visualizations including maps, slicers, and charts
keyInsights: Gross Profit Margin % varies significantly by country and market
Year-over-year profit margin trends highlight growth and decline periods
Monthly sales and profit trends reveal seasonal patterns
Interactive slicers enable dynamic analysis across years and metrics
businessImpact: Enabled data-driven decision making through clear sales and profit insights
Improved ability to identify high-performing markets and vendors
Facilitated monitoring of profitability trends to optimize business strategies
